ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 55-65% low-intensity (black) pixels and 35-45% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white marbling and dendritic mottling patterns concentrated on the interior of both lobes; solid black pigmentation dominates the regions adjacent to the trailing edges and the basal areas near the submerged notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible high-frequency serrations with irregular amplitudes along the interior trailing edges; approximately 8-10 distinct jagged peaks identified on the right lobe trailing edge before the outer tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer margins, sweeping upward and tapering into sharp, barnacle-encrusted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, textured, high-intensity yellowish-white pixel formations consistent with barnacle colonization localized heavily on the extreme outer tips and lateral margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear streaks (rake marks) cutting diagonally across the black pigment on the lower-center of the right lobe and central submerged region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive localized barnacle encrustations on the distal tips of both lobes; extensive white scarring across the ventral surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-contrast white marbling pattern covering nearly the entire central-to-lower portion of the right lobe visible above the waterline.
